Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 의뢰 실패를 실패한 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 저녁까지 대련을 요청했다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: After failing the quest, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> challenged me to spar with her until evening.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 依頼に失敗した<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>から、夜まで組手を頼みたいと言われた。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 未能完成委托的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>请求对练到晚上。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 未能完成委託的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>請求對練到晚上。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Après avoir échoué à la mission, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> m'a demandé de l'entraînement jusqu'au soir.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Nachdem sie die Quest nicht geschafft hatte, forderte mich <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> bis zum Abend zum Sparring heraus.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Tras fallar la misión, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> me retó a un duelo hasta el anochecer.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Após a falha na missão, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> pediu para treinarmos até o anoitecer.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: หลังจากภารกิจล้มเหลว <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ก็ขอให้ฝึกซ้อมจนถึงเย็นเลยค่ะ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Setelah misi gagal, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> meminta saya berlatih hingga malam.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Sau khi nhiệm vụ thất bại, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã yêu cầu đại luyện đến tối.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: अनुरोध में विफल होने के बाद, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने मुझे शाम तक उसके साथ अभ्यास युद्ध करने के लिए चुनौती दी।

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: I'll be with you to the end.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: จะอยู่เคียงข้างจนถึงที่สุด
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Sẽ ở bên bạn đến cùng.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: मैं अंत तक तुम्हारे साथ रहूँगा।

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_PRT: Vou te dar uma Poção de Vitalidade.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: รับยาเพิ่มพลังไปเลยค่ะ
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Tôi sẽ đưa cho bạn một Bình Thuốc Sinh Lực.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: यह रही एक जीवन शक्ति औषधि।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: I promised <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> we'd spar together until sundown.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 夜まで、<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>の相手になることを約束した。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: J'ai promis à <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> que nous nous entraînerions ensemble jusqu'au coucher du soleil.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Ich versprach <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>, dass wir bis Sonnenuntergang zusammen sparren würden.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Le prometí a <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> que entrenaríamos juntos hasta el anochecer.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Prometi a <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> que iríamos treinar juntos até o pôr do sol.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: ฉันสัญญากับ <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ว่าจะประลองด้วยกันจนถึงตะวันตกดินค่ะ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Aku berjanji pada <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> bahwa kami akan berlatih tanding bersama sampai matahari terbenam.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Tôi đã hứa với <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> rằng chúng tôi sẽ đấu tập cùng nhau cho đến khi mặt trời lặn.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: मैंने <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> से वादा किया कि हम सूर्यास्त तक एक साथ अभ्यास करेंगे।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> still couldn't shake off the shock of failure.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、失敗の衝撃から抜け出せないでいる。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>似乎未能从失败的打击中恢复。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>似乎未能從失敗的打擊中恢復。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> n'arrivait toujours pas à se remettre du choc de l'échec.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> konnte den Schock des Scheiterns immer noch nicht abschütteln.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> aún no podía sacudirse el impacto del fracaso.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ainda não conseguiu se livrar do choque do fracasso.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ยังคงไม่สามารถสลัดความตกใจจากความล้มเหลวออกไปได้ค่ะ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> masih belum bisa menghilangkan keterkejutan karena kegagalan.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> vẫn chưa thể thoát khỏi cú sốc thất bại.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> अभी भी विफलता के सदमे से उबर नहीं पाई थी।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> brightened up after receiving the potion.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、ポーションを受け取って喜んだ。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> s'est illuminé après avoir reçu la potion.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> hellte sich auf, nachdem sie den Trank erhalten hatte.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se animó tras recibir la poción.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ดูสดใสขึ้นหลังจากได้รับยาค่ะ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> menjadi ceria setelah menerima ramuan itu.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã vui vẻ sau khi nhận được bình thuốc.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: औषधि मिलने के बाद <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> का चेहरा खिल उठा।
